claims: As of April 16, 2026, the national average 30-year fixed mortgage APR is approximately 6.45%.
According to Bankrate and Mortgage News Daily, daily fluctuations see rates generally hovering between 6.3% and 6.5% for top-tier credit.
As of April 16, 2026, the average rate (no fees) for 30-year mortgages is ~6.37% - 6.38%.
As of April 16, 2026, the VA 30-year fixed mortgage rate is ~5.90%.
As of April 16, 2026, the FHA 30-year fixed mortgage rate is ~6.12%.
As shown on U.S. Bank and Bank of America, buying points can reduce your interest rate.
